universal nonlinear pi proof's final acceptance. No re-audit of that proof
or new parameter/source scan is claimed. Older files remain immutable.

1. Exact supplied channel and entropy interfaces

B is any finite-dimensional system, dim B=d. Sigma>0 is a supplied density.
Phi:M_d->M_d is a supplied full-domain Schrodinger CPTP channel satisfying
Phi(sigma)=sigma. Its Heisenberg adjoint Phi* is self-adjoint in
  <A,C>_sigma=Tr[sigma^(1/2)A* sigma^(1/2)C].
ONE actual full-domain CPTP broadcaster C:B->B tensor B has both marginals
Phi on EVERY input matrix. No modular/GNS covariance, positive channel
spectrum, spectral gap, primitivity, state-label input or reference bound
is assumed. Compatibility of a joint state alone is insufficient.

Define Gamma(X)=sigma^(1/2)X sigma^(1/2), G=Gamma^(1/2),
  G(X)=sigma^(1/4)X sigma^(1/4),
  T_Theta=G^(-1) Theta G for Schrodinger channels Theta.
The old weighted C4 theorem supplies ONE finite pure sigma-Petz canonical
EB comparator Psi, independent of rho and the reference:
  sigma=sum_z p_z pi_z, p_z>0, pi_z rank-one density,
  M_z=p_z sigma^(-1/2)pi_z sigma^(-1/2),
  Psi(X)=sum_z Tr(M_z X)pi_z,
  I-T_Psi <=4(I-T_Phi).                                (C4)
Both weighted channels are HS self-adjoint. T_Psi is a positive contraction.
Psi is an actual CPTP map and fixes sigma, not an abstract HS comparator.

source_excerpts.text:
Exact closure map and surviving raw power gates
Cycle08 tensor_frame_sol. No new target attack or numerical scan.

CLOSED CONDITIONAL COMPOSITION
Accepting the supplied universal nonlinear pi proof closes the finite
all-local-dimension genuine-entropy power gate for ONE supplied stationary,
KMS-reversible, full-domain self-compatible marginal Phi and ONE faithful sigma.
The same actual pure canonical comparator works on every state/reference and
at every Poisson orbit time. The quantum-reference coefficient is
24(2+sqrt(2))/pi; the scalar/classical coefficient is 24(1+1/sqrt(2))/pi.
The former GNS/modular restriction and qubit-only restriction are removed.
Faithfulness of tested rho is removed by finite regularization; faithfulness
of the fixed local sigma is retained. No minimum-eigenvalue factor is charged.

For joint states with B marginal sigma, genuine D becomes mutual information.
For varying B marginals, the extra D(rho_B||sigma) remains EXACTLY. Choosing
the untouched reference tau_R=rho_R on its support for each entropy calculation
does not choose a different comparator: both J and E cancel those reference
weights, while the local sigma/Phi/Psi are fixed throughout.

The simultaneous family theorem is in beta_sigma, the infimum over fixed-sigma
stationary KMS self-compatible channel marginals, and epsilon_sigma, the
infimum over pure sigma-Petz canonical channels. It gives squared-error power
exponent 2/3 with a genuine fixed-sigma information budget. Its compactness and
unnormalized-Choi trace bound explicitly support arbitrary finite reference
dimensions and exact optimal-map existence in a fixed finite local dimension.
The bound can alternatively be proved by near-optimal witnesses without
claiming any attainment. The C4 comparator of a beta-optimal channel is not
asserted to be epsilon-optimal.

UNCHANGED UNRESTRICTED RAW BOUNDARY
The earlier raw quantities are
  b2(E)=inf_(one full-domain CPTP B:B->B tensor B)
              sup_(rho in E) max_j T(B_j rho,rho),
  e(E)=inf_(one full-domain EB Lambda) sup_(rho in E)T(Lambda rho,rho),
  R(E)=inf_(sigma in closed conv E) sup_(rho in E)
           sup_(0<=F<=I) p ln(p/q), p=Tr F rho,q=Tr F sigma.
Raw marginals need not match, fix the chosen center, or be KMS symmetric.
The sought raw theorem is e(E)^2<=K[R(E)+1]b2(E)^alpha for a universal
alpha>0. The exact old lower family refutes every alpha>=2. Th
